---
name: Backup and restore
about: Help recovering saved articles or backup files after data loss or uninstall
labels: backup-restore
---

Before describing the problem, please answer these four questions. They determine which recovery path applies.

## Environment (answer first)

1. **Browser and version:** (Chrome / Edge / Firefox + version)
2. **Does `Downloads/PageBunker/` contain any `pagebunker-latest.json` or dated backup files right now?** (yes — how many / no / folder missing)
3. **Does the extension still have any articles visible in the library?** (yes — how many / no / extension uninstalled)
4. **What triggered the loss?** (uninstalled extension / reset browser profile / cleared extension data / import overwrote data / other)

---

## What is missing

Describe what you can no longer see: entire library, specific articles, recent changes only, article bodies vs links only, etc.

## What you still have

- [ ] Files in `Downloads/PageBunker/`
- [ ] Export from Pocket, Instapaper, or another tool
- [ ] In-browser backup (extension still installed, library partially visible)
- [ ] Nothing recoverable locally

List filenames or export sources if applicable (no need to paste private URLs).

## Steps already tried

What have you attempted? (reinstall, restore from backup file, merge vs replace, etc.)

## Extension version (if known)

Store build version or git commit if you built from source.

## Additional context

Timeline (when did it last work?), OS, and anything else relevant.
